CustomField.label: Offer days left
CustomField.description: SCRUM-467: whole calendar days left on the offer, measured at read. No offer or already expired = blank (never a negative count). System-computed formula field, read-only.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Offer_Expires_On__c), null, IF(Offer_Expires_On__c >= TODAY(), Offer_Expires_On__c - TODAY(), null))
